title: Orientation kit: template app runbook screenshots + annotated README diagrams
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Goal: Create a compact orientation kit for template apps used in quickstarts. Assets include high-fidelity screenshots of the reference app (hosted/dedicated/private variants), an annotated README diagram set (flow + callouts), and 2 short animated GIFs showing first-run flows. Deliverables: 1) Reference app screenshot pack (light + dark + 2x retina) 2) README diagram set (architecture + first-run flow + troubleshooting callouts) 3) GIFs: first-run onboarding + model-switch fallback 4) Accessibility annotations and alt-text for each asset.

Scope notes: This ticket covers only design assets and the annotated README diagrams. Engineering will consume assets for the docs site change under ENG-41210. PM sign-off required to confirm messaging for Dedicated and Private variants. Localization handled in follow-up (DES-98185).

Key constraints / trade-offs considered:
- File size vs fidelity: decided to prioritize retina PNGs for screenshots and SVGs for diagrams; GIFs capped at 1.5s loops to keep total docs bundle small.
- Single source of truth: Figma master file will contain export slices for hosted/dedicated/private to avoid mismatch with runtime screenshots.
- Accessibility: provide alt-text and separate description file so screenreaders on the docs site can read step captions.

Links to artifacts and references: Figma master above, PRD in Drive, draft copy in Confluence. Engineering ticket ENG-41210 for docs integration and schema. Observability dashboard linked for quickstart success metrics.

Requested assets (detailed):
- screenshots/reference-hosted-light@2x.png
- screenshots/reference-hosted-dark@2x.png
- screenshots/reference-dedicated-light@2x.png
- screenshots/reference-private-light@2x.png
- diagrams/readme-flow-annotated.svg (with labeled callouts: SDK init, model pin, KV cache indicator)
- diagrams/architecture-quickstart.svg (1-row: client -> routing -> runtime -> cache)
- gifs/first-run-walkthrough.gif (looped, ~1.2s)
- gifs/model-fallback-demo.gif (~1.0s)
- metadata/alt-texts.md (one line per asset)

Acceptance criteria:
- All image assets exported and verified against the running reference app (QA step).
- README diagrams uploaded as SVG and PNG fallbacks to Drive and linked in docs PR.
- Alt-text file completed and reviewed by Accessibility lead.
- PM and Eng have signed off in comments and the docs PR is green.

QA checklist included below.
acceptance_criteria: All assets exported in specified resolutions and uploaded to Drive
SVG diagrams imported in docs PR and render correctly on docs site
Alt-text file reviewed and approved by accessibility lead
PM confirms messaging for Dedicated/Private variants
Docs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/782) receives engineering review and approval
qa_checks: Compare screenshots to live reference app (URLs in Confluence) and record diffs if any
Run GIFs through size budget tool and keep under 400KB each
Verify SVGs scale at mobile breakpoints without overlap
Validate alt-text presence in markdown and talk-through for screenreader
decisions: Use 2x retina PNGs for screenshots to support high-DPI displays
Keep GIF durations short to reduce bundle size
Host master artboard in Figma and export via slices to maintain parity
